prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1348; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision that occurred in a parking lot and resulted in serious personal injuries to our client. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you confirm in writing the bodily injury liability limits of the policy issued to your insured, including any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply, along with the policy declarations page. Please also identify the claim number assigned to this matter and the adjuster handling it.

We further demand that your company and your insured preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes, without limitation, photographs, video footage from any parking lot or nearby cameras, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair estimates, recorded statements, claim file notes, and all communications with any party or witness. Any destruction or alteration of such material may result in sanctions.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
